bio.text: David Hatley, a Washington County businessman, is an independent candidate for governor of Tennessee in 2026, according to the Tennessee Lookout.

The Lookout reports that he is the owner of Whisper Outdoor, which began by manufacturing hot tubs and has expanded to golf carts, boats and off-road vehicles, and that he has not previously run for political office in Tennessee.

sources.title: Spoilers or contenders? Two independent candidates for TN governor try to shake up the race
